decisions.reason: The DOI 10.1099/ijs.0.02401-0 does occur at cp 2945 (inside the url= of the d1/d4 citation, a publisher URL). But the URL is not one of the forms that 3.5 quotes whole: the publisher-URL form is only one 'whose path contains /doi/10.', and this path is /content/journal/ijsem/10.1099/... with no /doi/ segment. So the row 'anything else' applies and the raw text is the identifier text itself, at cp 3004. Role identifier_link and key are unchanged. Ambiguity: a reader could take 'URL' to cover every publisher URL; the wording with /doi/ points the other way.

corrected_label.notes: publisher URL; the DOI is the last path segment but not under a /doi/ segment; labelled as identifier_link by best reading
